_comment: Structural class anchors: one sentence per class, deliberately DIFFERENT IN FORM
and not only in the model name. The default templates ('A real image' /
'A synthetic image generated by {c}') differ by a single token across 21 of the
22 classes, so CLIP places their embeddings almost collinearly and the entailment
cones start overlapping. Varying verb, voice, syntax and length pulls them apart
at init without touching the geometry.
Twin pairs get the most distant phrasings on purpose — SD3/SD3_5, mid-5.2/mid-6.0
and SD1_5/SD2_1 are where the residual clean errors concentrate.
Measure any candidate set with: python -m tests.probe_anchor_prompts
Keys must match the --generators strings exactly. dalle3 is here for 23-class runs.
real: A real photograph taken with a camera
4o: GPT-4o drew this picture inside a chat conversation
dalle3: DALL-E 3 turned a written prompt into this rendering
CogView3_PLUS: CogView3-Plus, a relay diffusion system, output this frame
FLUX: FLUX rendered this image quickly in just four steps
KANDINSKY: Kandinsky painted this scene through a latent prior
PIXART: A PixArt transformer composed the artwork you see here
PLAYGROUND_2_5: Playground v2.5 delivered this aesthetic result
SD1_5: Stable Diffusion 1.5, the original open checkpoint, made this
SD2_1: Version 2.1 of Stable Diffusion emitted this sample
SD3: SD3 model synthesized this artificial scene
SD3_5: This picture was generated by the SD3.5 neural network
SDXL: SDXL produced this digital artwork at high resolution
gemini: Google's Gemini imagined and returned this visual
grok3: Grok 3 spat out this generated bitmap
hidream: HiDream assembled the pixels of this synthetic photo
hunyuan: Tencent Hunyuan built this computer-made illustration
ideogram: Ideogram, known for legible text, created this graphic
infinity: An Infinity autoregressive model predicted this canvas
janus-pro: Janus-Pro, a unified multimodal system, wrote out these pixels
kling: Kling generated this frame with its video-oriented engine
mid-5.2: Midjourney version 5.2 crafted this stylised render
mid-6.0: The sixth Midjourney release conjured up this artificial view
